pondKeyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 photorealistic photo of the muddy bank of a rice paddy in the Mekong Delta, southern Vietnam, at golden hour. Seen from a low angle close to the ground. In the center, a tanned hand and forearm reach into a small round crab burrow in the wet brown mud of the paddy bank, with green rice plants and shallow water behind. Background: the flat rice field and a few coconut palms, softly blurred. Warm golden sunlight from the left. Keep the hand and the burrow inside the middle 70 percent of the width. No face visible. No text, no watermark.
